item.title: Curling: Japan’s Olympic Selection Process Post 2022 Missed Medals
item.description: Curling is a crucial sport for Japan, yet the nation has recently struggled in the international arena. The Japanese national team, Fortius, finished with a disheartening record of two wins and seven losses, failing to advance past the preliminary league. This disappointing performance means Japan misses the opportunity to secure medals for the third consecutive Olympic Games, having previously earned bronze in Pyeongchang 2018 and silver in Beijing 2022.
